# Project Review

Inspect `SPEC.md` and the changed notebook/source files. Check analytical correctness, data transformations, reproducibility, leakage risks, security, SOLID where applicable, DRY/KISS and pragmatic separation of concerns. Verify relevant project-specific checks in `SPEC.md`. Report actionable findings with file references and severity; distinguish verified defects from suggestions. Do not refactor unrelated code or invent tests/results.
